name: Mandalay Bay Resort & Casino
positioning: Las Vegas resort and casino with an 11-acre pool area called Mandalay Bay Beach, Shark Reef Aquarium and Michelob ULTRA Arena
best_for: Travelers who want a big pool scene with a wave pool and Lazy River
Guests who want shows, arena events and an aquarium under one roof

facts.text: Mandalay Bay Beach is an 11-acre aquatic playground at the resort.
The resort's pool area features real sand.
Mandalay Bay Beach has a wave pool, a Lazy River and a lagoon to lounge in.
Moorea Beach Club is a private, upscale pool experience.
Michael Jackson ONE by Cirque du Soleil is a fusion of acrobatics, dance and visuals set to Michael Jackson's music.
Michelob ULTRA Arena is a sports and entertainment complex that hosts top headliners and is home of the Las Vegas Aces and Desert Dogs.
The resort has a spa, Spa Mandalay.
The One Bedroom Penthouse Sky View Suite has neutral tones with aquatic finishes.
Orla is chef Michael Mina's Mediterranean restaurant.
Libertine Social is from James Beard Award-winning chef Shawn McClain.
The casino offers table games including blackjack, craps and roulette, and the resort has a BetMGM Sportsbook.

highlights.text: Mandalay Bay Beach is an 11-acre aquatic playground with real sand, a wave pool and a Lazy River.
At Shark Reef Aquarium, guests can view the creatures from inside a shipwreck or dive alongside the sharks.
Yoga with Sharks is a yoga experience held at Shark Reef Aquarium.
Michelob ULTRA Arena hosts top headliners and is home of the Las Vegas Aces.
Cabanas offer a private shaded space with lounge chairs and personal bar service.

considerations.text: This is a casino resort with an arena, a sportsbook and nightlife on site, so expect a lively, high-energy setting rather than a quiet retreat.
WhataHotel notes long walking distances between amenities in this large resort.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for attractions and dining.
